element.label: AZ 26-700 (single)
element.unitNote: single sheet pile: steel area at the toe plane, both faces of the developed section, one interlock engaged with the wall already driven

notes: Reference method q_s = q_c, τ_s = f_s (course §7.2): illustrative screen, not a pile design method.
δ_H = 0: optimistic free-acceleration baseline (course §8.1). Calibrate against measured amplitude (course §15.8).
Candidate F_c = 205 kN: refusal predicted at 5.00 m (m_R = 1.0) — mechanically possible down to 4.90 m of the 6.30 m target.
Force-envelope root: F_c,min(m_R=1) = 254.2 kN at 6.30 m; F_c,min(1.25) = 321.9 kN at 6.30 m.
Non-normative empirical model (course §7.1): confirm by an instrumented trial; check amplitude, clamp, power, wave stress and vibration separately (course §7.10).
